trailhead.label: Compatsch, Seiser Alm gondola top station

waypoints.label: Drinking-water tap at the Arnika Hütte
Dibaita Puflatschhütte, 67 m off the line

cautions: About 0.7 km of quiet paved road each way between the gondola and the loop (path 14), plus a short paved stretch in Compatsch, with hotel and service vehicles.
Short stone steps near the Puflatsch top station.
Pasture gates and electric fencing on the plateau.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
